both.summary: No special settings are recommended by this project: it runs with its defaults. Series S uses the PC upscaler only when VICTORY_FIDELITYFX_DIR is set.
The settings from the fork's own scripts\play.ps1 (same for AMD and Nvidia). FSR 4K and ray tracing are optional extras you can add in Launch Options.

env.name: VICTORY_THIN
env.desc: Faster, newer GPU submission path. If the game misbehaves, turn it off (0).

env.name: VICTORY_JOIN_PARTS
env.desc: Joins GPU work into bigger parts (8) to cut overhead.

env.name: VICTORY_UPLOAD_AHEAD
env.desc: Uploads data to the GPU ahead of time to avoid hitches.

env.name: VICTORY_TEXTURE_NO_WAIT
env.desc: Textures do not stall the frame while they stream in.

env.name: VICTORY_RELAY
env.desc: Faster command submission / copy handling from the fork's own play script.

env.name: VICTORY_RELAY_COPY
env.desc: Faster command submission / copy handling from the fork's own play script.

env.name: VICTORY_JOIN_COPIES
env.desc: Merges copy commands.

env.name: VICTORY_WIDE_BACK
env.desc: Wider write-back path for GPU buffers.

env.name: VICTORY_CARD_REHASH_RUNS
env.desc: GPU-side change tracking tuning.

env.name: VICTORY_CARD_STEPS
env.desc: GPU-side change tracking tuning.

env.name: VICTORY_CARD_AWAKE
env.desc: GPU-side change tracking tuning.

env.name: VICTORY_INDIRECT_WINDOW
env.desc: Batches indirect draws.

env.name: VICTORY_INDIRECT_BATCH
env.desc: Batches indirect draws.

env.name: VICTORY_MAP_THREADS
env.desc: Memory-mapping thread count.

env.name: VICTORY_TITLE_PRIORITIES
env.desc: Leaves the game's own thread priorities alone.

env.name: VICTORY_SHOW_AFTER
env.desc: Presents frames after their work is submitted.

env.name: VICTORY_AMBIENT
env.desc: Estimated indirect light (0.8) so shaded areas are not black.

env.name: VICTORY_D3D12_DRED
env.desc: Light crash tracing in case the GPU driver resets.

both.summary: The settings from the runner's own Play-VIctory.cmd (pareto residency). The author's launcher uses Series S: use the Series S/X button. Same for AMD and Nvidia.

env.name: VICTORY_AMBIENT_AIR
env.desc: Strength of the light in the air.

env.name: VICTORY_TEXTURE_NO_WAIT
env.desc: Textures do not stall the frame.

env.name: VICTORY_RELAY
env.desc: Command relay.

env.name: VICTORY_WIDE_BACK
env.desc: Wider write-back path.

env.name: VICTORY_CARD_REHASH_RUNS
env.desc: GPU-side change tracking.

env.name: VICTORY_JOIN_COPIES
env.desc: Merges copy commands.

env.name: VICTORY_INDIRECT_WINDOW
env.desc: Batches indirect draws.

env.name: VICTORY_RELAY_COPY
env.desc: Command relay for copies.

env.name: VICTORY_CARD_STEPS
env.desc: GPU-side change tracking.

env.name: VICTORY_INDIRECT_BATCH
env.desc: Batches indirect draws.

env.name: VICTORY_MAP_THREADS
env.desc: Memory-mapping thread count.

env.name: VICTORY_CARD_AWAKE
env.desc: GPU-side change tracking.

env.name: VICTORY_SHOW_AFTER
env.desc: Presents frames after their work is submitted.

env.name: VICTORY_AMBIENT
env.desc: Even constant light (0.8) instead of a per-frame estimate, which washed the frame out in bright doorways.

env.name: VICTORY_TEXTURE_GUARD
env.desc: Texture write guard off.

env.name: VICTORY_THIN
env.desc: Asynchronous submission off on NVIDIA (head skin was not drawn with it).

env.name: VICTORY_JOIN_PARTS
env.desc: Off on NVIDIA (repeated frames of the opening video).

env.name: VICTORY_PORT_GUARD
env.desc: Renderer port: write-guard lock sharing (saves 2-5 ms per frame).

env.name: VICTORY_PORT_JOURNAL
env.desc: Renderer port: journal split (saves 2-5 ms per frame).

env.name: VICTORY_PORT_CONSTANTS
env.desc: Renderer port 5 stays off (can raise a C++ exception).

env.name: VICTORY_PORT_CBV
env.desc: Renderer port 1 stays off (can drop road surfaces on 8 GB NVIDIA cards).

env.name: VICTORY_LIBRARY_STORE_LATER
env.desc: Saves the pipeline library later (no 200 ms hitches).

env.name: VICTORY_PIPELINE_WAIT_MS
env.desc: No pipeline wait (removes 500 ms frame stalls).

env.name: VICTORY_UPLOAD_AHEAD
env.desc: Uploads data ahead of time.

env.name: VICTORY_LEVELS_ON_DEMAND
env.desc: Texture levels on demand.

env.name: VICTORY_CARD_BUFFERS_MIN_KB
env.desc: Smallest buffer the change tracking watches (KB).

env.name: VICTORY_LOG
env.desc: Only warnings in the log (smaller, faster log).

amd.summary: DexNom 'Experimental RT' launch: ray tracing on, with local GPU memory, sparse texture mips and no upload-ahead. The FSR Quality 4K variant needs AMD's FSR 4.1.2 provider and a GPU that has it, so it is not forced; add VICTORY_FSR_4K and VICTORY_FIDELITYFX_DIR in Launch Options.

env.name: VICTORY_LOCAL_GPU_INPUTS
env.desc: Keeps GPU inputs in local video memory (--local-gpu-memory).

env.name: VICTORY_LEVELS_ON_DEMAND
env.desc: Requests sparse texture mips (--sparse-textures).

env.name: VICTORY_UPLOAD_AHEAD
env.desc: No upload-ahead (--no-upload-ahead).

nvidia.summary: DexNom's 'Experimental NVIDIA' launch: ray tracing off and the game's own display path, with an ambient-light fill instead of ray-traced light. NVIDIA gameplay is untested upstream.

env.name: VICTORY_FSR_4K
env.desc: No PC FSR 4K upscaler (it is AMD's).

env.name: VICTORY_AMBIENT_FALLBACK
env.desc: Lightweight ambient light so interiors are not black without ray tracing.

amd.summary: The play settings from the KLBF Lab README, plus the list of pipelines to skip that crash AMD's shader compiler. Their recommended Series S + FSR needs AMD's FidelityFX SDK (set VICTORY_FFX_DIR) and is not forced here. Use the Series S/X button.

env.name: VICTORY_SHADER_OPT
env.desc: Turns off the fork's shader clean-up passes, which crashed the AMD shader compiler.

env.name: VICTORY_LATE_WAIT
env.desc: Waits for GPU work later. If the device is lost about a minute after loading starts, try 0.

env.name: VICTORY_WIDE_BACK
env.desc: Wider write-back path for GPU buffers.

env.name: VICTORY_PIPELINE_WAIT_MS
env.desc: Time (ms) to wait for pipelines.

env.name: VICTORY_RELAY_COPY_QUEUE
env.desc: Copy queue relay off.

env.name: VICTORY_SKIP_PIPELINES
env.desc: Skips the pipelines that crash AMD's shader compiler (list from the runner's own docs).
